dogecoin.text: @mjeng54 You have to ask yourself if the future of an asset depends on the outcome of #SNL  do you really want to be invested in it?  #Comcast's future has less riding on this episode than dogecoin does.

When I was a littler kitten, my parents took me to Washington DC to tour the @usmint.  Outside there was a guy selling $3 bills yelling "get your funny money here" ... This is what I think of when @elonmusk talks about dogecoin.
